entities.summary: Adriana Aparecida dos Santos is a Brazilian former basketball player. As part of the national team, Adriana was world champion in the 1994 FIBA World Championship for Women, and appeared in three Olympic Games, Barcelona 1992, Atlanta 1996, and Sydney 2000, winning silver and bronze in the latter two.
